svg.title: One lap so far: a live-timing style circuit. A car laps the track, braking for corners, while mini-sectors light up, a speed trace follows it and a timing tower highlights five milestones: 2021 B.Sc. Biotechnology, Nashik; 2024 GATE-B, AIR 31; 2024 M.Sc. Bioinformatics, SPPU; 2025 CSIR-NET JRF, AIR 105; 2026 Ph.D., DDOmics Lab, NCCS.
